title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: 800-metre first-person rooftop course in six sectors with vaults, slides and wall-runs.

verification.notes: Stands on start roof (idle stable 0.5-5s). Sprint 49 km/h, assisted vault over first red barrier, crosses toward sector 02 roof by 5s. Round 1 fixed freeze after barrier reset; round 2 made localStorage keys game-unique.

fixRounds.issue: Holding W+Shift: after ~1s a red full-screen flash/reset, then player frozen at 0 km/h (READY) with keys still held; sprint-2000/5000 identical.
localStorage key rooftop-flow-best clashes with another game on the shared hub origin (astra-low); asked for game-unique keys.
